        "originalContents": "\n\n    def gum_input(self, prompt: str, placeholder: str = \"\", password: bool = False) -\u003e str:\n        \"\"\"Interactive input using gum.\"\"\"\n        if not self.available_tools.get('gum', False):\n            try:\n                return input(f\"{prompt}: \")\n            except EOFError:\n                return \"\"\n\n        cmd = ['gum', 'input', '--prompt', f\"{prompt}: \"]\n        if placeholder:\n            cmd.extend(['--placeholder', placeholder])\n        if password:\n            cmd.append('--password')\n\n        try:\n            result = subprocess.run(\n                cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)\n            return result.stdout.strip()\n        except (subprocess.CalledProcessError, EOFError):\n            try:\n                return input(f\"{prompt}: \")\n            except EOFError:\n                return \"\"\n\n    def gum_choose(self, prompt: str, options: List[str], multiple: bool = False) -\u003e str | List[str]:\n        \"\"\"Interactive selection using gum.\"\"\"\n        if not self.available_tools.get('gum', False):\n            print(f\"\\n{prompt}\")\n            for i, option in enumerate(options, 1):\n                print(f\"{i}. {option}\")\n            choice = input(\"Enter choice number: \")\n            try:\n                return options[int(choice) - 1]\n            except (ValueError, IndexError):\n                return options[0] if options else \"\"\n\n        cmd = ['gum', 'choose']\n        if multiple:\n            cmd.append('--no-limit')\n        cmd.extend(options)\n\n        try:\n            result = subprocess.run(\n                cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)\n            selected = result.stdout.strip().split(\n                '\\n') if multiple else result.stdout.strip()\n            return selected\n        except subprocess.CalledProcessError:\n            return options[0] if options else \"\"",
        "range": {

        "contents": "class CharmCLI:\n\n\n    ...\n\n\n    def gum_confirm(self, prompt: str, default: bool = True) -\u003e bool:\n        \"\"\"Interactive confirmation using gum.\"\"\"\n        if not self.available_tools.get('gum', False):\n            response = input(f\"{prompt} (y/N): \").lower()\n            return response in ['y', 'yes']\n\n        cmd = ['gum', 'confirm', prompt]\n        if default:\n            cmd.append('--default=true')\n        else:\n            cmd.append('--default=false')\n\n        try:\n            result = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)\n            return result.returncode == 0\n        except subprocess.CalledProcessError:\n            return default\n\n    def glow_render(self, content: str, style: str = \"auto\") -\u003e None:\n        \"\"\"Render markdown using glow.\"\"\"\n        if not self.available_tools.get('glow', False):\n            print(content)\n            return\n\n        try:\n            cmd = ['glow', '--style', style, '-']\n            subprocess.run(cmd, input=content, text=True, check=True)\n        except subprocess.CalledProcessError:\n            print(content)\n\n    def glamour_render(self, content: str, style: str = \"auto\", width: int = 80) -\u003e str:\n        \"\"\"Render markdown using glamour and return formatted string.\"\"\"\n        if not self.available_tools.get('glamour', False):\n            return content\n\n        try:\n            cmd = ['glamour', '--style', style, '--width', str(width)]\n            result = subprocess.run(cmd, input=content, text=True,\n                                    capture_output=True, check=True)\n            return result.stdout\n        except subprocess.CalledProcessError:\n            return content",

        "contents": "\n\n\nasync def main():\n    \"\"\"Main entry point for unified data ingestion\"\"\"\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(\n        description=\"Unified data ingestion for Disclosure RAG (dy command)\"\n    )\n    parser.add_argument(\"input\", help=\"URL or file path to process\")\n    parser.add_argument(\n        \"--upload\", \n        action=\"store_true\", \n        help=\"Upload to OpenAI Vector Store\"\n    )\n    \n    args = parser.parse_args()\n    \n    try:\n        if is_url(args.input):\n            if is_youtube_url(args.input):\n                result = await process_youtube_unified(args.input, args.upload)\n            else:\n                result = await process_web_unified(args.input, args.upload)\n        else:\n            result = await process_file_unified(args.input, args.upload)\n        \n        # Display results\n        print(\"\\n✅ Processing complete!\")\n        print(f\"Document ID: {result.get('doc_id', 'N/A')}\")\n        \n        if 'storage_results' in result:\n            print(\"\\nStorage Results:\")\n            storage = result['storage_results']\n            \n            # Handle nested results for YouTube\n            if 'transcript' in storage:\n                storage = storage['transcript']['storage_results']\n            \n            for backend, status in storage.items():\n                success = status.get('success', False)\n                icon = \"✅\" if success else \"❌\"\n                print(f\"  {icon} {backend}: {'Success' if success else status.get('error', 'Failed')}\")\n        \n        return 0\n        \n    except Exception as e:\n        logger.error(f\"Processing failed: {e}\")\n        print(f\"\\n❌ Error: {e}\")\n        return 1",

        "originalContents": "\n\n\nasync def main():\n    \"\"\"Main entry point for unified data ingestion\"\"\"\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(\n        description=\"Unified data ingestion for Disclosure RAG (dy command)\"\n    )\n    parser.add_argument(\"input\", help=\"URL or file path to process\")\n    parser.add_argument(\n        \"--upload\", \n        action=\"store_true\", \n        help=\"Upload to OpenAI Vector Store\"\n    )\n    \n    args = parser.parse_args()\n    \n    try:\n        if is_url(args.input):\n            if is_youtube_url(args.input):\n                result = await process_youtube_unified(args.input, args.upload)\n            else:\n                result = await process_web_unified(args.input, args.upload)\n        else:\n            result = await process_file_unified(args.input, args.upload)\n        \n        # Display results\n        print(\"\\n✅ Processing complete!\")\n        print(f\"Document ID: {result.get('doc_id', 'N/A')}\")\n        \n        if 'storage_results' in result:\n            print(\"\\nStorage Results:\")\n            storage = result['storage_results']\n            \n            # Handle nested results for YouTube\n            if 'transcript' in storage:\n                storage = storage['transcript']['storage_results']\n            \n            for backend, status in storage.items():\n                success = status.get('success', False)\n                icon = \"✅\" if success else \"❌\"\n                print(f\"  {icon} {backend}: {'Success' if success else status.get('error', 'Failed')}\")\n        \n        return 0\n        \n    except Exception as e:\n        logger.error(f\"Processing failed: {e}\")\n        print(f\"\\n❌ Error: {e}\")\n        return 1",

        "contents": "class DisclosureRAGCLI:\n\n    ...\n\n    def _process_single_file(self, ingestion: BulkFolderIngestion, file_path: Path) -\u003e bool:\n        \"\"\"Process a single file through the ingestion pipeline.\"\"\"\n        try:\n            # Run the async processing\n            loop = asyncio.new_event_loop()\n            asyncio.set_event_loop(loop)\n\n            try:\n                # Create document file object\n                from scripts.bulk_folder_ingestion import DocumentFile\n                doc_file = DocumentFile(\n                    path=file_path,\n                    name=file_path.name,\n                    size=file_path.stat().st_size,\n                    extension=file_path.suffix.lower(),\n                    mime_type=\"application/pdf\" if file_path.suffix.lower() == '.pdf' else \"text/plain\"\n                )\n\n                # Process document\n                result = loop.run_until_complete(\n                    ingestion.process_single_document(doc_file))\n                return result.get('success', False)\n\n            finally:\n                loop.close()\n\n        except Exception as e:\n            print(f\"Error processing {file_path.name}: {e}\")\n            return False\n",

        "originalContents": "\n    def _process_single_file(self, ingestion: BulkFolderIngestion, file_path: Path) -\u003e bool:\n        \"\"\"Process a single file through the ingestion pipeline.\"\"\"\n        try:\n            # Run the async processing\n            loop = asyncio.new_event_loop()\n            asyncio.set_event_loop(loop)\n\n            try:\n                # Create document file object\n                from scripts.bulk_folder_ingestion import DocumentFile\n                doc_file = DocumentFile(\n                    path=file_path,\n                    name=file_path.name,\n                    size=file_path.stat().st_size,\n                    extension=file_path.suffix.lower(),\n                    mime_type=\"application/pdf\" if file_path.suffix.lower() == '.pdf' else \"text/plain\"\n                )\n\n                # Process document\n                result = loop.run_until_complete(\n                    ingestion.process_single_document(doc_file))\n                return result.get('success', False)\n\n            finally:\n                loop.close()\n\n        except Exception as e:\n            print(f\"Error processing {file_path.name}: {e}\")\n            return False\n",

        "originalContents": "#!/bin/bash\n\n# Disclosure RAG Run Script\n# This script provides convenient commands for common operations\n\nset -e  # Exit on error\n\n# Colors for output\nRED='\\033[0;31m'\nGREEN='\\033[0;32m'\nYELLOW='\\033[1;33m'\nBLUE='\\033[0;34m'\nNC='\\033[0m' # No Color\n\n# Function to print colored output\nprint_status() {\n    echo -e \"${GREEN}[INFO]${NC} $1\"\n}\n\nprint_error() {\n    echo -e \"${RED}[ERROR]${NC} $1\"\n}\n\nprint_warning() {\n    echo -e \"${YELLOW}[WARNING]${NC} $1\"\n}\n\nprint_command() {\n    echo -e \"${BLUE}[CMD]${NC} $1\"\n}\n\n# Get the directory of this script\nSCRIPT_DIR=\"$( cd \"$( dirname \"${BASH_SOURCE[0]}\" )\" \u0026\u0026 pwd )\"\ncd \"$SCRIPT_DIR\"\n\n# Check if virtual environment exists\nif [ ! -d \".venv\" ]; then\n    print_error \"Virtual environment not found. Please run ./setup.sh first\"\n    exit 1\nfi\n\n# Activate virtual environment\nsource .venv/bin/activate\n\n# Check if .env file exists\nif [ ! -f \".env\" ]; then\n    print_error \".env file not found. Please create one based on .env.template\"\n    exit 1\nfi\n\n# Load environment variables\nsource .env\n\n# Function to show usage\n",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "case $COMMAND in\n    setup)\n        print_status \"Updating dependencies...\"\n        pip install --upgrade pip\n        pip install -e \".[dev]\"\n        print_status \"Dependencies updated successfully\"\n        ;;\n        \n    chat)\n        print_status \"Launching local chat interface...\"\n        python disclosure_chat.py \"$@\"\n        ;;\n        \n    agno-chat)\n        print_status \"Launching Agno chat interface...\"\n        python agno_disclosure_chat.py \"$@\"\n        ;;\n        \n    agno-chat-files)\n        print_status \"Launching Agno chat with file upload...\"\n        python agno_disclosure_chat_with_files.py \"$@\"\n        ;;\n        \n    process-url)\n        print_status \"Processing web content...\"\n        python main.py --scrape \"$@\"\n        ;;\n        \n    process-yt)\n        print_status \"Processing YouTube video...\"\n        python main.py \"$@\"\n        ;;\n        \n    process-file)\n        print_status \"Processing URLs from file...\"\n        python main.py --file \"$@\"\n        ;;\n        \n    test)\n        print_status \"Running tests...\"\n        pytest tests/ -v \"$@\"\n        ;;\n        \n    lint)\n        print_status \"Running linters...\"\n        print_command \"Running flake8...\"\n        flake8 . --exclude=.venv,build,dist\n        print_command \"Running mypy...\"\n        mypy . --exclude=.venv\n        ;;\n        \n    format)\n        print_status \"Formatting code...\"\n        print_command \"Running black...\"\n        black . --exclude=.venv\n        print_command \"Running isort...\"\n        isort . --skip=.venv\n        ;;\n        \n    ",

        "contents": "# Disclosure RAG - Command Cheatsheet\n\n**Quick Reference Guide - Updated June 25, 2025**\n\n## 🚀 Quick Start Commands\n\n### Launch Main Interfaces\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Web Dashboard (Recommended - Full Featured)\n./launch_dashboard.sh\n# Access: http://localhost:8501\n\n# Enhanced CLI Interface\npython cli.py\n\n# Knowledge Base UI\npython knowledge_base_ui.py\n\n# Basic Chat Interface\npython disclosure_chat.py\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 📥 Content Processing Commands\n\n### Process URLs (YouTube/Web)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Main processing script (enhanced)\npython main.py \"https://youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID\"\npython main.py \"https://example.com/article\" --upload\npython main.py \"https://example.com/article\" --no-kb\n\n# Shell script wrapper\n./main.sh process-url \"https://example.com/article\"\n\n# Direct YouTube processing\npython -c \"from lib.youtube import generate_transcript; generate_transcript('URL')\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Process Local Files\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Main processing\npython main.py \"/path/to/document.pdf\" --upload\npython main.py \"/path/to/file.txt\"\n\n# Shell script wrapper  \n./main.sh process-file \"/path/to/document.pdf\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Command Options\n\n- &#96;--upload&#96;: Upload to OpenAI vector store\n- &#96;--no-kb&#96;: Skip adding to local knowledge base\n- &#96;--status&#96;: Show integration status\n\n---\n\n## 🎛️ Interface Launch Commands\n\n### Web Dashboard (Streamlit)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Quick launch\n./launch_dashboard.sh\n\n# Manual launch\nstreamlit run streamlit_app.py\nstreamlit run streamlit_app.py --server.port 8502  # Custom port\n\n# Access URLs\nhttp://localhost:8501  # Default\nhttp://localhost:8502  # Custom port\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### CLI Interfaces\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Enhanced CLI (with Charm tools if available)\npython cli.py\n\n# Charm tools demo\npython charm_demo.py\n\n# Basic knowledge base CLI\npython knowledge_base_ui.py\n\n# Entity extraction CLI\npython entity_extraction_cli.py\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Chat Interfaces\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Local knowledge base chat\npython disclosure_chat.py\n\n# Note: Agno chat files referenced but may need setup\n# python agno_disclosure_chat.py\n",

[AGENT_ONBOARDING_CHECKLIST.md](AGENT_ONBOARDING_CHECKLIST.md)  **MANDATORY FIRST READ**  - Validation checklist\n\n## Development Commands\n\n### Main Application (Next.js)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Development\ncd apps/app\nbun run dev              # Start dev server\nbun run build           # Production build\nbun run start           # Start production server\nbun run lint            # Run ESLint\nbun run storybook       # Component development\n\n# Component generation\nbun run new             # Generate new component with Plop\nbun run bun:new         # Alternative Bun-based generator\n\n# Testing and analysis\nbun run audit:components # Component audit report\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### RAG System (Python)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Development\ncd apps/disclosure-rag\npython -m venv .venv \u0026\u0026 source .venv/bin/activate\npip install -r requirements.txt\n\n# Run applications\npython streamlit_app.py    # Interactive dashboard\npython api_server.py       # FastAPI server\npython cli.py             # Interactive CLI\n\n# Data processing\npython process_entities.py  # Entity extraction\npython main.py              # Main processing pipeline\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Database Operations\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Xata operations\ncd packages/db\nbun run seed            # Seed database\nbun run query           # Quick database query\nbun run analyze         # Database state analysis\n\n# Data import/export\ncd apps/app\nbun run export:xata     # Export Xata data\nbun run import:data     # Import data\nbun run import:events   # Import events specifically\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Architecture Overview\n\n### Monorepo Structure\n\n- **&#96;apps/app/&#96;** - Main Next.js application with research platform\n- **&#96;apps/disclosure-rag/&#96;** - Python RAG system with triple backend architecture\n",

[AGENT_ONBOARDING_CHECKLIST.md](AGENT_ONBOARDING_CHECKLIST.md)  **MANDATORY FIRST READ**  - Validation checklist\n\n## Development Commands\n\n### Main Application (Next.js)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Development\ncd apps/app\nbun run dev              # Start dev server\nbun run build           # Production build\nbun run start           # Start production server\nbun run lint            # Run ESLint\nbun run storybook       # Component development\n\n# Component generation\nbun run new             # Generate new component with Plop\nbun run bun:new         # Alternative Bun-based generator\n\n# Testing and analysis\nbun run audit:components # Component audit report\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### RAG System (Python)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Development\ncd apps/disclosure-rag\npython -m venv .venv \u0026\u0026 source .venv/bin/activate\npip install -r requirements.txt\n\n# Run applications\npython streamlit_app.py    # Interactive dashboard\npython api_server.py       # FastAPI server\npython cli.py             # Interactive CLI\n\n# Data processing\npython process_entities.py  # Entity extraction\npython main.py              # Main processing pipeline\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Database Operations\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Xata operations\ncd packages/db\nbun run seed            # Seed database\nbun run query           # Quick database query\nbun run analyze         # Database state analysis\n\n# Data import/export\ncd apps/app\nbun run export:xata     # Export Xata data\nbun run import:data     # Import data\nbun run import:events   # Import events specifically\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Architecture Overview\n\n### Monorepo Structure\n\n- **&#96;apps/app/&#96;** - Main Next.js application with research platform\n- **&#96;apps/disclosure-rag/&#96;** - Python RAG system with triple backend architecture\n",

        "contents": "# Claude Code Agent Coordination Rules\n\n## MANDATORY: Live Logging Protocol\n\nALL agents working on this codebase MUST use the live logging system for coordination.\n\n### Before Starting Any Work\n\n1. **Import the logging module**:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\nimport { appendEntry, computeAck } from \"./log.js\";\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. **Check in with your planned work**:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\nawait appendEntry({\n  agent: \"AGENT_A\", // Use your assigned agent name\n  type: \"checkin\",\n  ack: computeAck(\"AGENT_A\"),\n  sections: {\n    \"Summary\": \"- Brief description of planned work\",\n    \"Next (awaiting approval)\": [\n      \"1) First task\",\n      \"2) Second task\"\n    ]\n  }\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n3. **WAIT for USER approval** - Check LOG.md for:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n### [agent=USER seq=N ack=M type=approve ts=...]\n#### Approval\n- Proceed with steps...\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n4. **Only then proceed with implementation**\n\n### After Completing Work\n\nLog what you did:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\nawait appendEntry({\n  agent: \"AGENT_A\",\n  type: \"work\",\n  ack: computeAck(\"AGENT_A\"),\n  sections: {\n    \"Summary\": \"- What was accomplished\",\n    \"Did\": [\"- Specific changes\"],\n    \"Files changed\": [\"- file.js (+10 -5)\"]\n  }\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Coordination Rules\n\n- **NEVER** start work without checking in first\n- **NEVER** proceed without USER approval\n- **ALWAYS** log completed work\n- **ALWAYS** read LOG.md to see other agents' status\n- **ALWAYS** set ack to the last seq from others\n\n### Quick Commands\n\n- View log: &#96;cat LOG.md&#96; or &#96;npm run log:tail&#96;\n- Check in: &#96;npm run log:checkin&#96;\n- Log work: &#96;npm run log:work&#96;\n- Approve (USER): &#96;npm run log:approve&#96;\n\n## Agent Assignment\n\n- AGENT_A: Primary development agent\n- AGENT_B: Review/refactor agent\n- AGENT_C: Testing agent\n- USER: Human supervisor\n\nEach agent MUST use their assigned name consistently.\n",

Must be \u003e=3.9\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 2. **Virtual Environment Required**\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# NEVER work outside the virtual environment\nsource venv/bin/activate\n# Verify activation\nwhich python  #         "contents": "---\ndescription: Guide for using Task Master to manage task-driven development workflows\nglobs: **/*\nalwaysApply: true\n---\n# Task Master Development Workflow\n\nThis guide outlines the typical process for using Task Master to manage software development projects.\n\n## Primary Interaction: MCP Server vs. CLI\n\nTask Master offers two primary ways to interact:\n\n1.  **MCP Server (Recommended for Integrated Tools)**:\n    - For AI agents and integrated development environments (like Cursor), interacting via the **MCP server is the preferred method**.\n    - The MCP server exposes Task Master functionality through a set of tools (e.g., &#96;get_tasks&#96;, &#96;add_subtask&#96;).\n    - This method offers better performance, structured data exchange, and richer error handling compared to CLI parsing.\n    - Refer to [&#96;mcp.mdc&#96;](mdc:.cursor/rules/mcp.mdc) for details on the MCP architecture and available tools.\n    - A comprehensive list and description of MCP tools and their corresponding CLI commands can be found in [&#96;taskmaster.mdc&#96;](mdc:.cursor/rules/taskmaster.mdc).\n    - **Restart the MCP server** if core logic in &#96;scripts/modules&#96; or MCP tool/direct function definitions change.\n\n2.  **&#96;task-master&#96; CLI (For Users \u0026 Fallback)**:\n    - The global &#96;task-master&#96; command provides a user-friendly interface for direct terminal interaction.\n    - It can also serve as a fallback if the MCP server is inaccessible or a specific function isn't exposed via MCP.\n    - Install globally with &#96;npm install -g task-master-ai&#96; or use locally via &#96;npx task-master-ai ...&#96;.\n    - The CLI commands often mirror the MCP tools (e.g., &#96;task-master list&#96; corresponds to &#96;get_tasks&#96;).\n    - Refer to [&#96;taskmaster.mdc&#96;](mdc:.cursor/rules/taskmaster.mdc) for a detailed command reference.\n\n## Standard Development Workflow Process\n\n",

        "originalContents": "---\ndescription: Guide for using Task Master to manage task-driven development workflows\nglobs: **/*\nalwaysApply: true\n---\n# Task Master Development Workflow\n\nThis guide outlines the typical process for using Task Master to manage software development projects.\n\n## Primary Interaction: MCP Server vs. CLI\n\nTask Master offers two primary ways to interact:\n\n1.  **MCP Server (Recommended for Integrated Tools)**:\n    - For AI agents and integrated development environments (like Cursor), interacting via the **MCP server is the preferred method**.\n    - The MCP server exposes Task Master functionality through a set of tools (e.g., &#96;get_tasks&#96;, &#96;add_subtask&#96;).\n    - This method offers better performance, structured data exchange, and richer error handling compared to CLI parsing.\n    - Refer to [&#96;mcp.mdc&#96;](mdc:.cursor/rules/mcp.mdc) for details on the MCP architecture and available tools.\n    - A comprehensive list and description of MCP tools and their corresponding CLI commands can be found in [&#96;taskmaster.mdc&#96;](mdc:.cursor/rules/taskmaster.mdc).\n    - **Restart the MCP server** if core logic in &#96;scripts/modules&#96; or MCP tool/direct function definitions change.\n\n2.  **&#96;task-master&#96; CLI (For Users \u0026 Fallback)**:\n    - The global &#96;task-master&#96; command provides a user-friendly interface for direct terminal interaction.\n    - It can also serve as a fallback if the MCP server is inaccessible or a specific function isn't exposed via MCP.\n    - Install globally with &#96;npm install -g task-master-ai&#96; or use locally via &#96;npx task-master-ai ...&#96;.\n    - The CLI commands often mirror the MCP tools (e.g., &#96;task-master list&#96; corresponds to &#96;get_tasks&#96;).\n    - Refer to [&#96;taskmaster.mdc&#96;](mdc:.cursor/rules/taskmaster.mdc) for a detailed command reference.\n\n## Standard Development Workflow Process\n\n",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "# Meta-Development Script\n\nThis folder contains a **meta-development script** (&#96;dev.js&#96;) and related utilities that manage tasks for an AI-driven or traditional software development workflow. The script revolves around a &#96;tasks.json&#96; file, which holds an up-to-date list of development tasks.\n\n## Overview\n\nIn an AI-driven development process—particularly with tools like [Cursor](https://www.cursor.so/)—it's beneficial to have a **single source of truth** for tasks. This script allows you to:\n\n1. **Parse** a PRD or requirements document (&#96;.txt&#96;) to initialize a set of tasks (&#96;tasks.json&#96;).\n2. **List** all existing tasks (IDs, statuses, titles).\n3. **Update** tasks to accommodate new prompts or architecture changes (useful if you discover \"implementation drift\").\n4. **Generate** individual task files (e.g., &#96;task_001.txt&#96;) for easy reference or to feed into an AI coding workflow.\n5. **Set task status**—mark tasks as &#96;done&#96;, &#96;pending&#96;, or &#96;deferred&#96; based on progress.\n6. **Expand** tasks with subtasks—break down complex tasks into smaller, more manageable subtasks.\n7. **Research-backed subtask generation**—use Perplexity AI to generate more informed and contextually relevant subtasks.\n8. **Clear subtasks**—remove subtasks from specified tasks to allow regeneration or restructuring.\n9. **Show task details**—display detailed information about a specific task and its subtasks.\n\n## Configuration\n\nThe script can be configured through environment variables in a &#96;.env&#96; file at the root of the project:\n\n### Required Configuration\n- &#96;ANTHROPIC_API_KEY&#96;: Your Anthropic API key for Claude\n\n### Optional Configuration\n- &#96;MODEL&#96;: Specify which Claude model to use (default: \"claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219\")\n- &#96;MAX_TOKENS&#96;: Maximum tokens for model responses (default: 4000)\n- &#96;TEMPERATURE&#96;: Temperature for model responses (default: 0.7)\n- &#96;PERPLEXITY_API_KEY&#96;: Your Perplexity API key for research-backed subtask generation\n",
        "detailedLines": [

This script allows you to:\n\n1. **Parse** a PRD or requirements document (&#96;.txt&#96;) to initialize a set of tasks (&#96;tasks.json&#96;).\n2. **List** all existing tasks (IDs, statuses, titles).\n3. **Update** tasks to accommodate new prompts or architecture changes (useful if you discover \"implementation drift\").\n4. **Generate** individual task files (e.g., &#96;task_001.txt&#96;) for easy reference or to feed into an AI coding workflow.\n5. **Set task status**—mark tasks as &#96;done&#96;, &#96;pending&#96;, or &#96;deferred&#96; based on progress.\n6. **Expand** tasks with subtasks—break down complex tasks into smaller, more manageable subtasks.\n7. **Research-backed subtask generation**—use Perplexity AI to generate more informed and contextually relevant subtasks.\n8. **Clear subtasks**—remove subtasks from specified tasks to allow regeneration or restructuring.\n9. **Show task details**—display detailed information about a specific task and its subtasks.\n\n## Configuration\n\nThe script can be configured through environment variables in a &#96;.env&#96; file at the root of the project:\n\n### Required Configuration\n- &#96;ANTHROPIC_API_KEY&#96;: Your Anthropic API key for Claude\n\n### Optional Configuration\n- &#96;MODEL&#96;: Specify which Claude model to use (default: \"claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219\")\n- &#96;MAX_TOKENS&#96;: Maximum tokens for model responses (default: 4000)\n- &#96;TEMPERATURE&#96;: Temperature for model responses (default: 0.7)\n- &#96;PERPLEXITY_API_KEY&#96;: Your Perplexity API key for research-backed subtask generation\n",

        "contents": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nEnhanced CLI interface for Disclosure RAG using Charm CLI tools.\nIntegrates gum, huh, glow, glamour for interactive terminal experience.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport subprocess\nimport json\nimport sys\nimport os\nimport asyncio\nfrom typing import Dict, List, Optional, Any\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\n# Import bulk ingestion functionality\ntry:\n    from scripts.bulk_folder_ingestion import BulkFolderIngestion\nexcept ImportError:\n    BulkFolderIngestion = None\n\n\nclass CharmCLI:\n    \"\"\"Wrapper for Charm CLI tools integration.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self):\n        self.available_tools = self._check_available_tools()\n\n    def _check_available_tools(self) -\u003e Dict[str, bool]:\n        \"\"\"Check which Charm tools are available on the system.\"\"\"\n        tools = ['gum', 'huh', 'glow', 'glamour']\n        available = {}\n\n        for tool in tools:\n            try:\n                subprocess.run([tool, '--version'],\n                               capture_output=True,\n                               check=True,\n                               timeout=5)\n                available[tool] = True\n            except (subprocess.CalledProcessError, FileNotFoundError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):\n                available[tool] = False\n\n        return available",

        "contents": "### AI Integration\n\n1. Build on Contextual Intelligence foundation\n2. Use existing Prometheus AI for conversations\n3. Leverage Enhanced Nodes for UI consistency\n4. Follow established spatial intelligence patterns\n\n### Database Work\n\n1. Update Xata schema through dashboard first\n2. Run &#96;xata codegen&#96; to update types\n3. Test integration with existing contextual intelligence\n4. Maintain compatibility with 230,998+ existing records\n\n## Work Log Command\n\nWhen you receive the command \"/worklog\", automatically:\n\n1. **ANALYZE** recent work to determine:\n   - Primary focus area (frontend-ui, backend-api, database, testing, docs, deployment, research, bugfix, feature, refactor, integration, security)\n   - Files modified/created/deleted\n   - Time spent (estimate if needed)\n   - Key accomplishments\n\n2. **GENERATE** session ID using format: [focus-area]-[YYYYMMDD]-[HHMMSS]\n\n3. **AUTO-POPULATE** header with:\n   - Current date/time\n   - Generated session ID\n   - Detected focus area\n   - Your agent identifier\n   - Current branch/context\n\n4. **WRITE** comprehensive work log following template structure\n\n5. **ENSURE** all sections filled with specific, actionable information\n\n## Documentation Standards\n\n- **Always timestamp** documentation updates (EXACT DATE AND TIME)\n- **Always include** summary of work, files touched, components affected, next steps\n- **Use Python 3** and &#96;.venv&#96; for Python development\n- **Update this file** when finishing incremental tasks\n- **Prefer editing** existing files over creating new ones\n- **Never create** documentation files unless explicitly requested\n\n## Agent Review Procedures\n\n### @apps/app/ Review Process\n\n- Always review &#96;.claude/agents/apps-app-agent.md&#96; when working in &#96;@apps/app/&#96; directory\n- Ensure full compliance with agent-specific guidelines and context\n",

        "originalContents": "### AI Integration\n\n1. Build on Contextual Intelligence foundation\n2. Use existing Prometheus AI for conversations\n3. Leverage Enhanced Nodes for UI consistency\n4. Follow established spatial intelligence patterns\n\n### Database Work\n\n1. Update Xata schema through dashboard first\n2. Run &#96;xata codegen&#96; to update types\n3. Test integration with existing contextual intelligence\n4. Maintain compatibility with 230,998+ existing records\n\n## Work Log Command\n\nWhen you receive the command \"/worklog\", automatically:\n\n1. **ANALYZE** recent work to determine:\n   - Primary focus area (frontend-ui, backend-api, database, testing, docs, deployment, research, bugfix, feature, refactor, integration, security)\n   - Files modified/created/deleted\n   - Time spent (estimate if needed)\n   - Key accomplishments\n\n2. **GENERATE** session ID using format: [focus-area]-[YYYYMMDD]-[HHMMSS]\n\n3. **AUTO-POPULATE** header with:\n   - Current date/time\n   - Generated session ID\n   - Detected focus area\n   - Your agent identifier\n   - Current branch/context\n\n4. **WRITE** comprehensive work log following template structure\n\n5. **ENSURE** all sections filled with specific, actionable information\n\n## Documentation Standards\n\n- **Always timestamp** documentation updates (EXACT DATE AND TIME)\n- **Always include** summary of work, files touched, components affected, next steps\n- **Use Python 3** and &#96;.venv&#96; for Python development\n- **Update this file** when finishing incremental tasks\n- **Prefer editing** existing files over creating new ones\n- **Never create** documentation files unless explicitly requested\n\n## Agent Review Procedures\n\n### @apps/app/ Review Process\n\n- Always review &#96;.claude/agents/apps-app-agent.md&#96; when working in &#96;@apps/app/&#96; directory\n- Ensure full compliance with agent-specific guidelines and context\n",

        "contents": "- **Scalability Roadmap**\n    - Multi-database Support - Provider registry supports multiple databases\n    - Enhanced Search - More sophisticated search capabilities\n    - Performance Optimization - Continued query and type system optimization\n    - Advanced AI Integration - More sophisticated AI-powered features\n\n### Resources\n\n- [Xata Documentation](https://xata.io/docs)\n- [Bun Documentation](https://bun.sh/docs)\n- [TypeScript Handbook](https://www.typescriptlang.org/docs/)\n\n### Internal Documentation\n\n- &#96;packages/db/IMPORT_GUIDE.md&#96; - Comprehensive usage guide\n- &#96;packages/db/QUICK_REFERENCE.md&#96; - Common patterns and examples\n- &#96;packages/db/TYPE_SYSTEM_SUMMARY.md&#96; - Type system overview\n- &#96;packages/db/xata/api/XataAskSDK_DOCUMENTATION.md&#96; - AI features documentation\n\n*Last Updated: 2025-06-25*\n*Package Versions: @db v0.1.0*\n\n## CODING STANDARDS\n\n* Code should be well-documented and follow consistent formatting.\n* All code must adhere to TypeScript type safety.\n* Use named exports for functions, avoiding default exports.\n* Error handling should be robust and informative.         "contents": "---\ndescription: Guidelines for creating and maintaining Cursor rules to ensure consistency and effectiveness.\nglobs: .cursor/rules/*.mdc\nalwaysApply: true\n---\n\n- **Required Rule Structure:**\n  &#96;&#96;&#96;markdown\n  ---\n  description: Clear, one-line description of what the rule enforces\n  globs: path/to/files/*.ext, other/path/**/*\n  alwaysApply: boolean\n  ---\n\n  - **Main Points in Bold**\n    - Sub-points with details\n    - Examples and explanations\n  &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n- **File References:**\n  - Use &#96;[filename](mdc:path/to/file)&#96; ([filename](mdc:filename)) to reference files\n  - Example: [prisma.mdc](mdc:.cursor/rules/prisma.mdc) for rule references\n  - Example: [schema.prisma](mdc:prisma/schema.prisma) for code references\n\n- **Code Examples:**\n  - Use language-specific code blocks\n  &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n  // ✅ DO: Show good examples\n  const goodExample = true;\n  \n  // ❌ DON'T: Show anti-patterns\n  const badExample = false;\n  &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n- **Rule Content Guidelines:**\n  - Start with high-level overview\n  - Include specific, actionable requirements\n  - Show examples of correct implementation\n  - Reference existing code when possible\n  - Keep rules DRY by referencing other rules\n\n- **Rule Maintenance:**\n  - Update rules when new patterns emerge\n  - Add examples from actual codebase\n  - Remove outdated patterns\n  - Cross-reference related rules\n\n- **Best Practices:**\n  - Use bullet points for clarity\n  - Keep descriptions concise\n  - Include both DO and DON'T examples\n  - Reference actual code over theoretical examples\n  - Use consistent formatting across rules ",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "# Technology Stack\n\n## Build System \u0026 Package Management\n- **Runtime**: Bun (JavaScript/TypeScript), Python 3.9+\n- **Monorepo**: Turborepo with workspace configuration\n- **Package Manager**: Bun for JS/TS, pip/conda for Python\n\n## Frontend Stack\n- **Framework**: Next.js 15.3.5 with App Router\n- **React**: 19.1.0 with React Server Components\n- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS 4.1.11 + Radix UI components\n- **3D Graphics**: Three.js, React Three Fiber, React Three Drei\n- **Animations**: Framer Motion, GSAP\n- **State Management**: Zustand, React Context\n- **Real-time**: Liveblocks, PartySocket\n\n## Backend \u0026 Data\n- **Database**: Xata (PostgreSQL) with vector search capabilities\n- **Vector Storage**: Multi-backend (Upstash Vector, FAISS, pgvector)\n- **AI/ML**: OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq via Vercel AI SDK\n- **Authentication**: Clerk\n- **File Storage**: Vercel Blob, Xata file attachments\n\n## Python RAG System\n- **Framework**: FastAPI, Streamlit\n- **AI/ML**: LangChain, sentence-transformers, torch\n- **Vector DBs**: FAISS, Upstash Vector, CocoIndex (pgvector)\n- **Document Processing**: PyPDF2, PyMuPDF, BeautifulSoup4\n- **CLI**: Charm CLI tools (gum, huh, glow, glamour)\n\n## Development Tools\n- **TypeScript**: 5.8+ with strict configuration\n- **Linting**: ESLint 9.30+ with Next.js config\n- **Component Development**: Storybook 8.6+\n- **Testing**: Jest, Storybook testing utilities\n- **Code Generation**: Plop for component scaffolding\n\n## Common Commands\n\n### Development\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Start main app\nbun run dev:app\n\n# Start Storybook\nbun run storybook\n\n# Python RAG system\ncd apps/disclosure-rag\npython streamlit_app.py    # Dashboard\npython api_server.py       # API server\npython cli.py             # Interactive CLI\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Build \u0026 Deploy\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Build main app\nbun run build:app\n\n# Start production\nbun run start:app\n\n# Component audit\nbun run audit:components\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Data Operations\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Export Xata data\nbun run export:xata\n\n# Import data\nbun run import:data\nbun run import:events\n",
